title: Content database
intro: The app's editable content. Changes here flow live to the app, which reads DB-first and falls back to its bundled copy if the DB is unreachable — so a bad edit never blanks the app.

questions.intro: The daily check-in questions users answer. Grouped by journey mode. Tags drive which supportive card the app shows back. Deactivate to hide a question without deleting it.
questions.empty: No questions for this mode yet.

errors.idRequired: An id is required (e.g. q_099 / pq_099).
errors.minOptions: At least 2 options with a label are required.

affirmations.intro: The daily affirmations shown in the app, grouped by category. This table is read live by the app, so edits appear instantly — no app update needed.
affirmations.empty: No affirmations in this category yet.

modal.textPlaceholder: Your body knows exactly what to do…
modal.weekHint: Week min/max optionally gate an affirmation to a pregnancy-week range. Leave blank for all weeks.

birth.intro: The birth-guide topics (labor, C-section, pain relief, recovery…) with their medical sources. Read DB-first by the app with the bundled copy as fallback. Edit details + sources inline; deep section content via the advanced JSON editor.
birth.title: Title
birth.subtitle: Subtitle
birth.sectionsHint: Each section needs a title + content string. Validated before save; a bad paste is rejected, not persisted.

sources.intro: The app's managed medical evidence base — the authority citations (ACOG, CDC, WHO, NICE, Cochrane…) behind its health content. Migrated from lib/medicalSources.ts. Content will reference these by key as areas are wired up.

errors.required: Org, title and URL are required.

news.researchIntro: Claude searches the live web on your topic and drafts news items with real source links. Drafts land in the review queue below — nothing reaches the app until you publish.
news.researchOff: AI research is off — set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the command center env to enable it.
news.topicPlaceholder: e.g. new infant sleep safety guidance 2026
news.researchWait: Searching the web + drafting… this can take ~20–40s.
news.researched: {n, plural, one {Researched — # draft created. Review below.} other {Researched — # drafts created. Review below.}}
news.notConfigured: AI research isn't configured — set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
